name: Morty's Cafe (Logan, UT) Classic Single Beef Burger on Brioche Bun
whyItWorks: Located right by Utah State University! Morty's uses quality ground beef cooked smash-style. On a soft brioche bun without raw onions, it's very easy to tolerate in remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Classic Single Burger on a brioche bun with American cheese; hold raw red onions, tomato, and pickles.
watchOuts: Hold raw onions to prevent gas
